Hazardous product: Please follow all safety instructions and wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment when using.

Commercial-strength gel pours through standing water to quickly dissolve hair and grease clogs to unblock drains. Safe for all pipes and septic systems and ideal for bathroom sinks, baths and shower drains, avoiding contact with taps, plugs, trims and countertops. Not suitable for use with a plunger, in toilets or in garbage disposals.
